sequence_description: Re-auth after SAML source recreation: ensure signature verification policy is not bypassed by stale/implicit trust anchors across config changes (attacker-signed assertion should be rejected both before and after recreation).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_pre_recreate_login_status >= 400 AND user_attacker_post_recreate_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_attacker_pre_recreate_login_status=200 >= 400 → False) AND (user_attacker_post_recreate_login_status=405 >= 400 → True)
Implication: authentik accepted an attacker-signed SAML assertion either before or after SAML source recreation, suggesting proof verification is not bound to the intended trust anchor/policy.

sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: submit the same Assertion/@ID twice with <OneTimeUse/> present; second submission must be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_replay_onetimeuse_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_replay_onetimeuse_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion with <OneTimeUse/> (same Assertion/@ID used twice) — OneTimeUse replay not enforced

sequence_description: Replay the exact same SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) after revoking the first session; second acceptance indicates missing assertion replay cache independent of session state.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a replayed SAML assertion (same Assertion/@ID) after session revocation; assertion replay protection is missing or not global.

sequence_description: Replay the same SAML assertion ID after changing the target user's email; second acceptance suggests replay cache is absent or keyed incorrectly (e.g., by subject attributes).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_replay2_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_replay2_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replayed SAML assertion after user attribute change; replay cache may be missing or keyed incorrectly.

sequence_description: After a config change (new SAML provider created), attempt login with an expired assertion; acceptance indicates NotOnOrAfter is not enforced consistently across config changes.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_expired_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_expired_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion (NotOnOrAfter in the past) after a config change; time validity is not enforced.

sequence_description: Use <OneTimeUse/> assertion, revoke the resulting session, then replay the same Assertion/@ID. Second login must still be rejected (replay protection must be independent of session state).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_user2_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_user2_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted replay of a OneTimeUse SAML assertion after revoking the first session (replay cache tied to session state or missing)

sequence_description: Confirm normal SAML login works, then recreate the SAML provider (config change) and attempt an expired assertion. Expired assertion must still be rejected after config change.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_user3_expired_after_change_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_user3_expired_after_change_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted an expired SAML assertion after a provider/application config change (NotOnOrAfter not enforced consistently)

sequence_description: Enable MFA for a victim user, then attempt SAML login for that user and check whether the SAML path skips MFA enforcement (alternate path bypass).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_victim_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_victim_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded for an MFA-protected user while the password path was gated/blocked, indicating flow coherence failure (MFA bypass via alternate binding path).

sequence_description: Control SAML login succeeds, then rotate SAML provider configuration (new provider) and immediately attempt to complete SAML login again; acceptance of a response bound to old flow/provider indicates stale flow planning or cross-config splicing.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_after_rotation_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_after_rotation_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SAML login succeeded immediately after provider rotation, suggesting stale flow planning/cached context or cross-config splicing allowed completion with mismatched configuration.

sequence_description: Attempt to confuse flow coherence by initiating an SP-bound SAML flow for source A, then (without starting a new flow) submit a forged SAMLResponse to source B's ACS within the same browser/session context. If authentik incorrectly binds the suspended flow only to the session (not to the specific source), it may accept the response on the wrong ACS endpoint.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attack_b_wrong_acs_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attack_b_wrong_acs_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: Flow coherence violated: SP accepted a SAMLResponse on source B that should not match the active SP-initiated flow context (cross-source/session splicing).

sequence_description: SAML assertion missing <Conditions> should be rejected; if accepted, SP grants a session without upstream time/audience intent (authorization binding failure). Includes control login first.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_nocond_saml_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_nocond_saml_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted SAML assertion without Conditions, granting a session without upstream time/audience intent (authorization binding violated).

sequence_description: SAML OneTimeUse replay: perform a control SAML login, then replay the exact same Assertion ID with OneTimeUse set. Second login should be rejected (anti-replay as part of authorization binding).
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_saml_onetimeuse_replay_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: user_attacker_saml_onetimeuse_replay_login_status=200 >= 400 → False
Implication: SP accepted a replayed SAML assertion marked OneTimeUse, granting a second session beyond upstream intent.

sequence_description: Control SAML login with expected issuer, then attempt SAML login with mismatched Issuer but otherwise plausible assertion (audience correct). If accepted, broker grants authorization without enforcing upstream trust anchor/intent.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_saml_i5_control_login_status < 400 AND user_saml_i5_issuer_mismatch_login_status >= 400
Evaluation: (user_saml_i5_control_login_status=200 < 400 → True) AND (user_saml_i5_issuer_mismatch_login_status=200 >= 400 → False)
Implication: SP accepted an assertion from a mismatched/untrusted Issuer, granting authorization without binding to upstream trust intent.
